# The news-and-markets pack

*News and markets* · version 1.0.0 · code `NWMK`

## What it is

A sample pack built on two on-demand connectors: fifteen news topics (central banks, countries, companies, themes) and twenty
well-known listed companies, each company with a live quote and price history (Yahoo Finance) and every topic and company with its
headlines (Google News). Internal demonstration only; off until its connectors are enabled. Offline, the demo lake serves a captured
snapshot.

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

### `news-topic`

**News topic** · mnemonic `TOPIC`.

**Id:** field `TOPIC_ID`; pattern `^TOPIC-`; for example `TOPIC-FED`.

Fields, from 15 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TOPIC_ID` | string | `TOPIC-FED` | The document's id |
| `NAME` | string | `Federal Reserve` | Topic |
| `CATEGORY` | string | `Central bank` | Category |
| `ALIASES` | list of strings |  | Other names the news connector searches for |
| `ALIAS_TEXT` | string | `Fed, FOMC, Powell` | Other names |
| `EDITION` | string | `default` | Edition |
| `NEWS_ID` | string | `NEWS-Federal_Reserve` | link to `news` |
| `NEWS_ALL_ID` | string | `NEWS-Federal_Reserve~all` | link to `news` |
| `ECONOMY` | string | `ECON-IND` | The topic's economy (world-economy pack) (in 33%) |

Links: `NEWS_ALL_ID` → `news`, `NEWS_ID` → `news`.

### `news`

**Headlines** · mnemonic `NEWS` · read through connector `news`.

**Id:** pattern `^NEWS-`.

No samples ship: documents are read live from its connector `news` (plugin `news`). The fields its screens show:

| Field | Shown as |
|---|---|
| `COUNT` | Headlines |
| `EDITION` | Edition |
| `ENTITY` | Entity |
| `FETCHED_AT` | Fetched |
| `RELEVANCE_FILTER` | Relevance filter |

### `listed-company`

**Listed company** · mnemonic `CO`.

**Id:** field `COMPANY_ID`; pattern `^CO-`; for example `CO-AAPL`.

Fields, from 20 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COMPANY_ID` | string | `CO-AAPL` | The document's id |
| `TICKER` | string | `AAPL` | Ticker |
| `NAME` | string | `Apple Inc.` | Company name |
| `ALIASES` | list of strings |  | Other names the news connector searches for |
| `ALIAS_TEXT` | string | `Apple Inc, AAPL, iPhone` | Other names |
| `EXCHANGE` | string | `Nasdaq` | Exchange |
| `SECTOR` | string | `Technology` | Sector |
| `COUNTRY` | string | `US` | Country |
| `ECONOMY` | string | `ECON-USA` | Country economy (world-economy pack) |
| `QUOTE_ID` | string | `QUOTE-AAPL` | link to `quote` |
| `NEWS_ID` | string | `NEWS-Apple` | link to `news` |
| `NEWS_ALL_ID` | string | `NEWS-Apple~all` | link to `news` |

Links: `NEWS_ALL_ID` → `news`, `NEWS_ID` → `news`, `QUOTE_ID` → `quote`.

### `quote`

**Quote and price history** · mnemonic `QUOTE` · read through connector `yfinance`.

**Id:** pattern `^QUOTE-`.

No samples ship: documents are read live from its connector `yfinance` (plugin `yfinance`). The fields its screens show:

| Field | Shown as |
|---|---|
| `CHANGE` | Change |
| `CHANGE_PCT` | Change % |
| `CURRENCY` | Currency |
| `EXCHANGE` | Exchange |
| `MARKET_STATE` | Market |
| `PRICE` | Price |

## Screens and commands

| Command | Kind | Opens |
|---|---|---|
| `TOPIC` | `news-topic` | News topic |
| `NEWS` | `news` | Headlines |
| `CO` | `listed-company` | Listed company |
| `QUOTE` | `quote` | Quote and price history |
| `NWMK` | — | The pack's overview: its kinds, how many each holds, an example of each |

Examples:

| Type | Shows |
|---|---|
| `TOPIC TOPIC-FED` | Federal Reserve · headlines, count by source, how they were selected |
| `TOPIC TOPIC-OIL` | Oil prices · a theme rather than an entity |
| `TOPIC TOPIC-TOYOTA` | Toyota · the Japanese edition |
| `NEWS NEWS-Bitcoin` | Any name works: the headlines for bitcoin, not from the list |
| `CO CO-AAPL` | Apple · quote, six months of prices, headlines |
| `CO CO-XOM` | Exxon Mobil · energy |
| `QUOTE QUOTE-MSFT` | Any ticker works: the quote and history for MSFT |

Screens (Sutras):

| Sutra | Kind | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `listed-company` | `listed-company` | A listed company: its live quote and price history (yfinance connector) and its news headlines (news connector), both computed on demand. |
| `news-topic` | `news-topic` | A topic and the news about it: headlines (newest first) with their publishers and links, a count by source, and how the headlines were chosen. |
| `news` | `news` | The headlines for one name, as the news connector computed them: newest first, filtered for relevance, duplicates removed. |
| `quote` | `quote` | A quote and recent price history for a ticker, as the yfinance connector computed them. |

## Data sources and licences

| Source | Licence | Internal only | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hand-written reference data (topics and listed companies) | Proprietary (part of Drishti) | no | news-topic, listed-company |
| Google News RSS (news connector) | Headlines belong to their publishers; no redistribution | yes | news, read live when the news connector is on |
| Yahoo Finance (yfinance connector) | Unofficial endpoint; terms restrict use and forbid redistribution | yes | quote, read live when the yfinance connector is on |
| Captured snapshot of the same quotes and headlines (data/testdata) | As above; committed for the offline demo machine by the owner's choice | yes | the offline demo lake |

Every kind's data contract (each column: type, key, example, links) and where its data comes from (an external source and its refresh script, a generator of synthetic data, or a Drishti engine) are in the guide, [guides/news-and-markets.md](guides/news-and-markets.md): *Data contracts* and *Data retrieval*.

External data: Google News RSS (news connector) (**internal only**); Yahoo Finance (yfinance connector) (**internal only**); Captured snapshot of the same quotes and headlines (data/testdata) (**internal only**). Each source's URL, licence, refresh script and worked examples (Linux and Windows) are on the External data help page, [docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md](../../../docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md).

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on no other pack.

A sample pack: Admin → Packs can hide it from business users (`drishti.packs.samples`).

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `news` | `news` | `news` | `${DRISHTI_NEWS_ENABLED:false}` |
| `yfinance` | `yfinance` | `quote` | `${DRISHTI_YFINANCE_ENABLED:false}` |
| `news-store` | `delta` | `news-topic`, `listed-company`, `news`, `quote` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_DELTA_ROOT`, `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_NEWS_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_NEWS_URL`, `DRISHTI_YFINANCE_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_YFINANCE_URL`.

## Refreshing the data

The topics and companies are written by `config/packs/news-and-markets/tools/make_samples.py`; the offline snapshot by
`tools/publicdata/news_and_markets.py`.

`python3 tools/publicdata/news_and_markets.py status` lists the external sources, their licences and when each was last refreshed (offline); `refresh --dry-run` shows what a refresh would fetch and write, changing nothing; `refresh` fetches, writes and checks. The External data help page (docs/guides/PUBLIC_DATA.md) has worked examples for Linux and Windows.

The pack's files are written by `tools/packgen/readme.py news-and-markets`; its `--check` fails when the committed files differ from what it would write.
